records.title: Exactly simulating stochastic chemical reaction networks in sub-constant time per reaction
inspection: Full relevant Theorem 5.1 and efficiency proof, making_time_work.tex:11-26,451-511
Exact hypoexponential construction and ARS assumption, making_time_work.tex:177-343
Fixed-time terminal algorithm and correctness, making_time_work.tex:345-449
Uniformization definitions/transformation and collision-batching relevant proofs
findings: Deterministic transformed-event blocks permit independent clocks.
ARS PDF-evaluation bound is explicitly assumed following a tentative cited proof.
Eq. (1) binomial convention requires catalyst correction by binom(m,delta), rather than falling factorial without delta!.
Physical scale kappa/v^(o-1) must be retained.

records.title: The distribution of the sum of independent gamma random variables
inspection: All four scanned pages viewed; pp.542-543 Eqs.(2.3)-(2.9)
findings: The positive gamma-series law and logarithmic coefficients sum_i alpha_i q_i^r/r are prior.
Inspected paper computes coefficients recursively; no indexed sparse-query compiler stated.

records.title: Efficient Sampling from Phase-Type Distributions
inspection: Full six-page accepted manuscript; Sections 2-3 exact algorithm and resource account
findings: Uniformize a continuous phase-type distribution, sample the discrete absorption count, then one gamma.
Generic precomputation O(N^3 M); alias table construction O(N(N+M)).
Strongest inspected general exact gamma/count competitor; no formula-oracle no-scan specialization stated.
